_instructions: OWNER-ONLY DECISION FILE. Copy this template, fill every required field, and keep it out of version control if it contains personal/legal data.
Nothing is inferred from the presence of media files. Empty, null, or 'pending' means NOT DECIDED and downstream tools must refuse to advance the corpus.
Then generate per-frame attribution with: python3 tools/datasets/emit_attribution_notices.py --attestation <your-file> --attribution-map <map.json>
AVA / AADB / EVA may never be marked production_allowed, redistribution_allowed, or admitted; the validator rejects that outright (D01/D05 audit).
